title: Exploring the genetic landscape of ciprofloxacin-induced DNA supercompaction in Escherichia coli.
authors: Vikedal, Krister; Berges, Natalia; Riisnaes, Ida Mathilde Marstein; Raeder, Synnove Brandt; Bjornholt, Jorgen Vildershoj; Bjoras, Magnar; Skarstad, Kirsten; Helgesen, Emily; Booth, James Alexander
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习辅助高通量筛选研究大肠杆菌中环丙沙星诱导的DNA超压缩相关基因，虽涉及DNA损伤响应和机器学习，但核心是细菌表型筛选，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: DNA-damaging antibiotics like ciprofloxacin (CIP) induce extensive double-strand breaks in Escherichia coli, triggering both the SOS response and rapid DNA supercompaction. To uncover genes involved in the latter process beyond the previously identified key orchestrators encoded by recN and recA, we developed a novel machine learning-assisted high-throughput screening workflow and applied it to nearly 4000 E. coli strains, including the Keio collection's single-gene deletion strains and additional in-house strains. Conservative validation identified 15 hit strains with impaired DNA supercompaction. While defects in recombinational repair genes were associated with the most severe impairments, our investigation also revealed genes not previously associated with DNA compaction or repair that had milder and more heterogeneous effects on supercompaction, including yaiW, which encodes a membrane-associated protein. Notably, several non-DNA-repair gene deletions affected RecN colocalization with the nucleoid, recN expression, SOS response activity, or survival after CIP exposure, supporting indirect or modulatory roles. Altogether, this work confirms RecN and RecA as primary drivers of DNA supercompaction and demonstrates that high-content imaging combined with machine learning-assisted analysis provides a scalable approach to explore bacterial DNA organization phenotypes and DNA damage responses.
abstract_zh: 像环丙沙星（CIP）这类损伤DNA的抗生素会在大肠杆菌中诱导广泛的DNA双链断裂，同时触发SOS反应和快速的DNA超压缩。为了发现除先前鉴定的由recN和recA编码的关键调控因子之外参与后一过程的基因，我们开发了一种新型的机器学习辅助高通量筛选工作流程，并将其应用于近4000株大肠杆菌菌株，包括Keio集合中的单基因缺失菌株和额外的内部菌株。保守验证确定了15个DNA超压缩受损的命中菌株。虽然重组修复基因的缺陷与最严重的损伤相关，但我们的研究还揭示了先前未与DNA压缩或修复关联的基因，这些基因对超压缩具有较温和且更异质的影响，包括编码膜相关蛋白的yaiW。值得注意的是，几个非DNA修复基因的缺失影响了RecN与拟核的共定位、recN表达、SOS反应活性或CIP暴露后的存活率，支持其间接或调节性作用。总体而言，这项工作确认了RecN和RecA是DNA超压缩的主要驱动因子，并证明高内涵成像结合机器学习辅助分析为探索细菌DNA组织表型和DNA损伤反应提供了一种可扩展的方法。
